services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Experience San Francisco Fleet Week from the best seat on the bay. Join us on Friday, October 9, Saturday, October 10, or Sunday, October 11, for an unforgettable afternoon cruise with front-row views of the spectacular Fleet Week Air Show. Leave the crowded waterfront behind and enjoy unobstructed views from the water as the U.S. Navy Blue Angels and other talented aviators perform thrilling aerial demonstrations over San Francisco Bay. With panoramic outdoor decks and comfortable indoor seating, you'll have plenty of opportunities to take in the action and capture incredible photos. services.name: Whale fluke
services.desc: In collaboration with the Pacific Whale Foundation, we are offering an unforgettable 2.5-hour whale watch tour from Fisherman’s Wharf onboard our state-of-the-art hybrid electric passenger vessel. Featuring live naturalist narration and the opportunity to observe Gray, Humpback, and Blue Whales, along with seals, sea lions, seabirds, and other local wildlife. Stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the rugged Marin Headlands. Full bar available with snacks and indoor/outdoor seating.
